title: Chapter 264
text:
The Pro League was divided into many different modes, and the Arena was naturally the most suitable for single elimination matches and individual matches. According to Han Technician's experience, if there was a ready-made arena, the chances of the Pro League being held in his territory were quite high. After all, the arenas for the first Pro League in his previous life were all built by the players themselves. Although it sounded like a bunch of bullsh * t, doing it personally made the players feel great.

If the Pro League was held in his territory, the status of the "main city" would be even more stable. It would also bring in a lot of people. In Han Technician's eyes, they were all potential customers. He was aiming for the Pro League to make a fortune. The temporary status enhancement potions in his hands would definitely sell well in this kind of situation.

However, there was a small problem. The Pro League would be held around the time when the first batch of players reached level 60. If he had to wait for the Pro League to start, he would have to stay in Blue Star for quite some time.

I'll just treat it as preparing for the interstellar journey. Besides, I have to wait for an opportunity, Han Xiao thought to himself.

It was not that easy to leave a planet. In Version 0, all the novice planets did not have the usual channels to travel to the interstellar. If it was a novice planet that had more contact with interstellar civilizations, he might have been able to think of a few simple methods. For example, on Winterfrost, the Void Demons had interstellar battleships. Han Technician might have been able to find a way to get one.

However, on Blue Star, the countries here could not even build stable interstellar spaceships. The chances of flying into the sky and standing shoulder to shoulder with the sun were very slim.

However, it was not completely hopeless. Ever since he decided to leave Planet Aquamarine in Version 0.0, he began to search for all kinds of details in his memory. After a long time of thinking, he really did find a few unexpected opportunities, but he had to wait for those things to happen naturally before the opportunity presented itself.

Therefore, he really did have the time to wait for the Pro League to start.

At that time, the pioneers will basically be at level 60. If I don't find a suitable subclass, I should still be at level 70. Han Xiao was not worried at all. His strength was one version higher, and he had the BSS Template. With all kinds of machinery and combat skills, even if there were players who wanted to die, he would be able to kill a group of forty people by himself.

However, once the strength of the players increased, the other forces would be dumbfounded. They would view the "Inhumans" as a great enemy, and the situation of Blue Star would change again.

Only he was as steady as an old dog.

Aurora timidly hid behind Hella. It was the first time that she had seen so many people. She was shocked and was not used to it.

"This is your territory?" Hella raised her eyebrows in surprise. She never thought that there would be so many Inhumans here. Moreover, it seemed that Han Xiao had a huge influence among the Inhumans. She found it hard to understand this point.

Because Han Xiao had been in the limelight recently, the Blue Star section on the forums was in full swing. The players in the sanctuary all wanted to see him up close.

Along the way, there were players everywhere, and there were eager and thirsty gazes from all directions. He inexplicably felt like he was on a parade … If it weren't for the guards clearing the way, he always felt that these hungry players would have pounced on him together.

When they returned to the upper level of the sanctuary, it was finally quiet.

Han Xiao settled the two down and said, "Huang Yu, arrange two rooms for them. They will live here from now on …" He thought about it and changed his mind. "Never mind, one room is enough."

"Please follow me." Huang Yu extended his hand and led the two of them away.

After the few of them left, he was the only one left in the room. Han Xiao laid on the bed to rest for a while, then closed the door and windows, locked himself in the study, picked up a pen, and wrote down the focus of his next move on a piece of paper.

Since he was preparing to leave the planet, he naturally had to list the various opportunities on Blue Star. He also wrote down the opportunities to leave the galaxy in detail, adding from time to time to prevent himself from missing any details.

Finally, the tip of the pen paused.

"… So, I want to earn as much EXP as possible from the players on Blue Star, because after leaving the planet, it means that I won't have any interactions with the players in the short term. In order to maintain my influence, I have to do my best to improve the players' main city, add various functions, and provide convenient transportation. Then, the players who are active in the main city will think of me from time to time … I might as well build a statue to remind them …"

He burned the paper full of words to ashes, not leaving any clues. It was already late at night, and Han Xiao went to another house. This was the special residence that he had arranged for Mad Blade and the other three. This treatment was not given to the other players.

Mad Blade was the only one left in the house. He had been waiting for Han Xiao, and he was overjoyed immediately and greeted him.

"Just you?" Han Xiao looked left and right, then set a simple mission with rich rewards and threw it to Mad Blade.

Finally, he was rewarded again.

Mad Blade was overjoyed.

Following Black Phantom gave him a bright future. This mission was so interesting. Singing and dancing gave him EXP. The other missions were so lame.

The Pro League was coming, and Han Xiao was also preparing to train these few close players so that they could perform better in the Pro League.

Han Technician was quite generous to his own people. After all, these players had helped him a little. At the same time, if they had more stable results, the other players would believe that there were benefits to following him.

Now, his mission reward limit had also increased, and he could satisfy the needs of more players.

The total daily reward was seven times more than the single mission reward, which was around 800,000 EXP. It was very generous. Han Xiao was a little envious. If only he could have the EXP limit, he would not have to worry about EXP. Unfortunately, this method did not work.

Sigh, I still have to take advantage of the players.

After spending an entire day dealing with the miscellaneous matters, Dean's supplies finally arrived. Following which, Han Xiao locked himself in the workshop and began his closed-door training to organize his gains.

The Germinal Organization's Mechanic class advanced knowledge is, this is one of the most important knowledge for Mechanics. It allows the control of machines to be upgraded. As long as the corresponding chip program is written, it can read the brain signals and send out commands. The speed of thinking is much faster than speaking or using hand gestures.

He spent some Potential Points to upgrade to level five. Basic knowledge required one Potential Point to upgrade, Advanced Knowledge required two Potential Points, and so on. The cost was getting higher and higher. Therefore, Han Xiao had been hoarding Potential Points and only used them on the most important knowledge.

The first task was to recreate the mechanical suit that had been destroyed. This time, Han Xiao did not plan to copy the mechanical suit completely according to the blueprint. He wanted to add his own creativity on top of this foundation to create an enhanced version of the mechanical suit. He already had a draft in mind.

There was a large pile of parts and supplies beside the lathe. Han Xiao counted them, rubbed his hands, and smiled confidently.

"Time to work."

…

The seventh day.

Chi!

Accompanied by the sound of cold air leaking, the metal cooling box opened. Inside was a transparent, high-strength glass cylindrical box filled with light blue liquid. Han Xiao removed the synthetic repair gel used to cool down and speed up the fusion. A brand new battle suit appeared in front of him, still emitting white cold air.

"It's finally done. I'm so tired." Han Xiao felt refreshed. He rubbed his cheeks vigorously to relieve the slight tiredness from staying up for a few days straight.

The new generation battle suit still used the core principle of Viper Modified. It was filled with PE-0 nanofiber muscles and provided torque along with movement. It could still increase strength and agility, and none of the original weapon modules were missing.

The outer appearance was the same style as Viper Modified. The dark suit was dotted with blue energy transmission pipes. The structure was more precise and complicated, and the whole body was streamlined. However, there were some changes. The size was larger, and the edges were more defined, like protruding scales. The overall feeling was completely different.

If Viper Modified was like a small poisonous snake hunting, the new generation battle suit was like a black python waiting for its prey in the shadows. It was fine if it did not move, but when it moved, it would strike like lightning.

Ferocious!

Dangerous!

In reality, Han Technician could have copied Viper Modified in three days, but this time, he took seven days.
